result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **1Password or Bitwarden**\. Both are excellent, but they serve slightly different priorities.

My overall pick is **1Password for ease of use** and **Bitwarden for value**\.

## Best password managers for small teams

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password**

(Best overall for usability)

# \$8.99

Per user/month, annual billing (Business)

- Excellent user experience
- Shared vaults for departments and projects
- Strong administrator controls
- Access management and employee offboarding
- Security monitoring through Watchtower

[1Password business plans](https://1password.com/business)

- Good cross-platform support

![‎Keeper Password Manager App - App Store](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6YqDIYCwAfpd6GObzC-G1I_Ae64PhD3Adg6yFTCDbBzmw2aNf2KsneQTuxazrol31Rc6ACKK3x9Eh1luvNAHDI1r711RPuAeW2f0aAFmjVsqzUYe4jhRFTDwXTW7NUhBUV3qqwhS9yrU3ZD-hUKGwId-qbRcNIdL4KiaJcX6Q-NTBSa05phiAGYremJ0qUvL?purpose=fullsize)

- Password health monitoring

## My recommendation

| Your priority | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| Easiest for employees | 1Password |
| Best price/features | Bitwarden |
| More security administration | Keeper |
| Security monitoring | Dashlane |


For a team of 5–20 people, I'd shortlist 1Password and Bitwarden.

## A few things I'd insist on

Whichever you choose, make sure it supports\:

- **Shared vaults\:** Share company credentials without sending passwords over Slack or email.
- **Individual accounts\:** Every employee has their own login.
- **Role-based permissions\:** Employees only see credentials they need.
- **Offboarding\:** Immediately revoke access when someone leaves.
- **MFA\:** Require multifactor authentication.
- **Audit logs\:** Know who accessed or changed shared credentials.
